note: COORDINATION, not rebuild: the 12 V2 proof systems in showcase/effects-v2-proof-20261031/ are NOT rebuilt here. This map only wires them to CJ shots from shot-specs-30-20261031.json + god-ray-placement-30-20261031.json. Shot specs carry no effect_systems field — where a system is only inferable (not named), it is PROPOSED, not counted as wired.

systems.production: Blender: Principled Volume cube (Density 0.02, Anisotropy 0.5) + Spot light; compositor Glare Sun Beams added back over original (Effects V2 §1)
systems.gate: atmosphere + shadow (shaft pool on ground; character rim from shaft side)
systems.evidence: god-ray-placement-30-20261031.json: 9 Level-3 placements; 21 explicit Level-2 no-god-ray decisions (CJ-01..CJ-10, CJ-15..CJ-18, CJ-20, CJ-21, CJ-23..CJ-27). Per-shot production frames still owed — the V2 proof frame is a generic arms-up proof, not a per-shot frame.

systems.system: Bloom / glow with light spill onto nearby surfaces
systems.production: Blender: emissive object (Strength >1) + real Point light at same position; compositor Glare Fog Glow, Threshold 0.8, Size 8, Mix ADD (Effects V2 §2)
systems.gate: spill (glow must brighten ground + character near side, spill colour in key hue family)
systems.evidence: CJ-03 shot spec: 'impact cue + gauntlet glow cue' and 'impact energy + gauntlet glow are Level 4 FX passes'. PROPOSED (not wired): CJ-30 neon glow, CJ-11 stage spotlight glow — not named in those specs.

systems.system: Atmospheric scattering / haze / fog that shifts with the grade
systems.production: Blender: World Volume or bounded Principled Volume cube, Noise Texture into Density 0.001–0.05; fog colour follows grade/shift (Effects V2 §3)
systems.gate: atmosphere (distant silhouettes soften; air takes grade colour)
systems.evidence: No shot spec names fog per shot. Proposed for the 9 god-ray shots because the V2 method ties haze to the same volume cube — but it is NOT wired until a shot spec names fog_type/density/colour.

systems.system: Particle systems: dust, sparks, embers, rain/snow
systems.production: Blender particle system, emissive icosphere instances, light-interacting (Effects V2 §4)
systems.gate: atmosphere + shadow (particles inside a shaft sparkle; embers light ground beneath them)
systems.evidence: CJ-03 impact implies the system-5 dust burst (120 particles, lifetime 12), but no shot spec names a particle system directly. Dance sparkle pops are flat markers, NOT production VFX — not counted as wired.

systems.system: Impact shockwave + ground dust + light flash (2–3 frames)
systems.production: Blender: expanding ring (scale 0.2→3.0, opacity 1→0) + dust burst + Point flash 1500→0 over 3 frames (Effects V2 §5)
systems.gate: shadow + atmosphere (scene brightens 2–3f, shadows pop, dust ring lingers one beat)
systems.evidence: CJ-03 is the locked impact frame; shot spec names 'impact energy' as a Level 4 FX pass. PROPOSED (not wired): CJ-22 jump landing dust — landing dust is not named in CJ-22's spec.

systems.system: Fire / energy aura with flickering light
systems.production: Blender: emissive aura geometry + flickering Point light (noise driver ±25%/frame) + Glare Fog Glow (Effects V2 §6)
systems.gate: spill + shadow (near side + ground pool pulse with the aura)
systems.evidence: CJ-03 'gauntlet glow / impact energy' FX pass. Shares its source with system 2 on this shot — one glow source, two system descriptions, not two separate glows.

systems.production: Blender: ground Principled roughness 0.15 in puddle mask, 1.0 elsewhere; flipped darkened blurred subject copy at 0.35 opacity (Effects V2 §7)
systems.gate: spill (lights stretch into streaks on wet ground)
systems.evidence: Painted alley background (used by CJ-08/CJ-30) already paints puddle reflections, but no shot spec names a production wet-surface pass. Painted reflections are background art, not the V2 system.

systems.system: Smoke / steam with shadow and rim interaction
systems.production: Blender: second volume, Density 0.05, Anisotropy 0.3, rim Spot from behind (Effects V2 §8)
systems.gate: shadow + atmosphere (smoke shadow side darkens ground; lit edge glows in key hue)
systems.evidence: No CJ shot names smoke or steam. Listed as unwired, not hidden.

systems.system: Motion blur + speed lines following the action arc
systems.production: Blender compositor Vector Blur (samples 32) + speed lines ALONG the limb arc from pose joint path (Effects V2 §9)
systems.gate: atmosphere (action reads fast without the character going soft)
systems.evidence: Gap-audit punch exposure sheet has a PIL smear DRAFT only (explicitly not production) for the CJ-01/02 punch; CJ-14 is a dive. No shot spec names Vector Blur/speed lines — Blender pass owed before either counts as wired.

systems.system: Depth of field + lens effects (bokeh, anamorphic flare)
systems.production: Blender camera DOF (focus = character plane, f/2.8) + Defocus on background + Glare Streaks aligned to light source (Effects V2 §10)
systems.gate: spill (flare axis points at the light source; bokeh from bright background points)
systems.evidence: Rooftop sunset/night-city shots have bright background points (sun, city lights) that suit DOF/bokeh, but no shot spec names DOF or flare per shot.

systems.system: Electricity / lightning with scene-wide flash + shadow pop
systems.production: Blender: emissive jagged bolt + flash 0→4000→0 over 4 frames + shadow soft size 0.8→0.1→0.8 (Effects V2 §11)
systems.gate: shadow (every shadow sharpens for one peak frame)
systems.evidence: No CJ shot names lightning/electricity. Listed as unwired, not hidden.

systems.production: Blender: every effect light use_shadow on; soft size 0.5 (spot) / 0.8 (point); Eevee volumetric shadows on; ground receives (Effects V2 §12)
systems.gate: shadow (an effect that casts no shadow is not production — it floats on top of the scene)
systems.evidence: Not a standalone shot effect: it is the pass/fail gate every wired system must pass on its shots. CJ-01..CJ-10 Level-2 shots etc. carry no effect light, so the gate is vacuous there, not failed.

still_owed: per-shot production VFX frames for every wired shot (V2 proof frame is generic, not per-shot)
shot-spec effect_systems fields naming the proposed systems before they count as wired
